# Confirmations
A few issues here. Duplicate records for volId 45 on weeks 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-17.
There is also a mix of NA values and empty strings that I think are meant to represent an NA value.
For migration, will consider any empty strings to be an NA
```{r}
names(old_data$confirm)

# old_data$confirm |> 
#   unnest(cols = dias)

# Check duplicates
old_data$confirm |> 
  # unnest(cols = dias) |> 
  count(volId, semana, bloque) |> 
  filter(n > 1)

# Check if duplicates are identical
old_data$confirm |> 
  filter(volId == 45,
         semana %in% c("2026-08-03", "2026-08-17")) |> 
  select(id, volId, semana, bloque, dias) |> 
  unnest(dias)
```
```{r}
# double check empty string in dias columns for single week
old_data$confirm |>
  filter(volId == 45, semana == "2026-08-17") |>
  unnest(cols = dias) |>
  select(id, Martes, Jueves, Viernes, Miércoles, Lunes) |>
  mutate(across(-id, ~ case_when(is.na(.x) ~ "MISSING (NA)",
                                 .x == "" ~ "EMPTY STRING",
                                 TRUE ~ .x)))

old_data$confirm <- old_data$confirm |> 
  mutate(volId = as.character(volId))

# look at missingness across all weeks in dias
confirm_missigness <- old_data$confirm |>
  select(id, volId, dias) |> 
  unnest(cols = dias) |>
  pivot_longer(c(-id,-volId), names_to = "dia", values_to = "estado") |> 
  mutate(estado = case_when(is.na(estado) ~ "MISSING (NA)",
                            estado == "" ~ "EMPTY STRING",
                            TRUE ~ estado))

# write_csv(confirm_missigness, "confirm_missingness.csv")
```

This is how dias are handled in the original index.html
The volunteer interface creates a new confirmation obs `dias:{}`
```{html}
# original
  # const toggle=(id,dia)=>setConfirm(confirm.map(r=>{
  #   if(r.id!==id)return r;
  #   const actual=r.dias[dia]||"";
  #   if(actual==="asistio"||actual==="falta")return r;
  #   return {...r,dias:{...r.dias,[dia]:actual==="confirmado"?"":"confirmado"}};
  # }));

# More readable
# Toggle fn with params id and dia
# setConfirm() is React state setter; receives updated data from logic inside it
# .map() iterates over the array, r represents single record at a time
const toggle = (id, dia) => setConfirm(confirm.map(r => {
  
  # Find the confirmation record corresponding to selected row; leave other records unchanged
  if (r.id !== id) return r;
  
  # Get current status for selected day
  # If day has no status treat as an empty string
  const actual = r.dias[dia] || "";
  
  # If attendance has already been assigned by admin, vol can't change it
  if (actual === "asistio" || actual === "falta") return r;
  
  # Update status for selected day
  return {
    # ... is a spread operator, gives full info of the properties for that object
    ...r,
    dias: {
      ...r.dias,
      # If true, day was previously selected, so deselect
      # Else, confirm availability
      [dia]: actual === "confirmado" ? "" : "confirmado"
    }
  }
}));
```
